newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson plans 2nd HK Seibu store late '97.
newsitem.headline: Dickson plans 2nd HK Seibu store late '97.

text.p: Luxury retailer Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd said its Hong Kong Seibu unit would open a new department store in the Causeway Bay district in late 1997 and restructure its Pacific Place store.
Hong Kong Seibu has leased the ground floor and basement levels of Windsor House in Causeway Bay, chairman Dickson Poon told a news conference on Thursday.
The restructuring of the Pacific Place store, involving a new layout, introduction of new and installation of an electronic information system, would be substantially completed by mid-1997.

"Once the restructuring of the Pacific Place store is completed and the second store at Windsor House is opened, the group is confident that the longer-term growth prospects of Hong Kong Seibu are assured and that Dickson Concepts will receive strong recurring income from this subsidiary," Poon said.
He declined to specify how much the plans would cost.

Dickson acquired an 85 percent stake in Hong Kong Seibu Enterprise Co Ltd in June by injecting HK$180 million into the company by subscribing to 100 million new shares and making a shareholder's loan of HK$80 million.
